import pandas as pd

# Get recent trips (last 30 days of data)
trips = tables['trips']
now_doy = 182

# Filter recent trips for S06
recent = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 6) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] >= now_doy - 30)].copy()

# Calculate metrics by class and day
daily_stats = recent.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'cls': 'first',
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'boat': 'nunique'
}).reset_index()

# Calculate yt per angler
daily_stats['yt_per_angler'] = daily_stats['yt'] / daily_stats['anglers'].clip(lower=1)

# Also get by class
class_stats = recent.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'boat': 'nunique'
}).reset_index()
class_stats['yt_per_angler'] = class_stats['yt'] / class_stats['anglers'].clip(lower=1)

print("=== Daily summary (d152-d182) ===")
print(daily_stats[['fish_date_doy', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler', 'boat']].to_string())

print("\n=== By class (d170-d182, recent) ===")
recent_class = class_stats[class_stats['fish_date_doy'] >= 170].sort_values('fish_date_doy')
print(recent_class[['fish_date_doy', 'cls', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler']].to_string())

# Check water temp
pier_data = tables['pier']
recent_pier = pier_data[(pier_data['ts_season'] == 6) & (pier_data['ts_doy'] >= 170)].copy()
if len(recent_pier) > 0:
